_comment: People in the caves. Place in Tiled as 'npc' point objects (feet) with property npc_id. 'shop' is a shop id from shops.json; quests are offered in order, one at a time.

hob.name: Old Hob
hob.greeting: Another one come looking for the deep, eh? Name's Hob. I trade, if you've got coin.
hob.idle: Mind the moss in the Hollow. Slick as soap.
